_comment: One-Command End-to-End Vertex AI Deployment Configuration for Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on a Reserved 4-GPU G4 Node (g4-standard-192) in me-central2 (me-central2-a). Replace YOUR_GCP_PROJECT_ID, YOUR_GCS_BUCKET_NAME, and YOUR_RESERVATION_NAME, then run: ./deploy.sh

compute._machine_type_comment: g4-standard-192 provides 4x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 (384 GB total GDDR7 VRAM), 192 vCPUs, and 720 GB System RAM
compute._capacity_type_options: reserved (uses Compute Engine reservation in me-central2-a), standard (On-Demand), or spot

reservation._affinity_type_options: SPECIFIC_RESERVATION (targets reservation.name in reservation.zone), ANY_RESERVATION (consumes any matching automatic reservation), or NO_RESERVATION
reservation.name: YOUR_RESERVATION_NAME

vllm._engram_cpu_offload_comment: Required on 4-GPU g4-standard-192: offloads 189.12 GiB Engram N-gram table to 720 GB host RAM so GPU weights use only 60.75 GiB/GPU and leave >20 GiB/GPU (1.27M tokens) for KV cache

pipeline_stages.verification_prompt: fais moi un poeme de 12 vers en arabe et la traduction en anglais
